title: passovia stelis
intro: Passovia stelis, commonly known as Passiflora stelis, is a species of flowering plant in the Passifloraceae family. It is a type of passionflower plant, known for its medicinal properties and unique appearance. The health benefits of Passovia stelis include its potential to reduce anxiety and insomnia, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Passovia stelis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including sedative and anxiolytic effects.
